quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya PCB IR presentation: MOPS 804620260611E001 (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nan Ya PCB 2026Q1 operation briefing: 1Q26 consolidated revenue NTD 11.1 Billion, 32.1% above 1Q25 on sustained data-center demand and increased high-end IC substrate sales, and 0.1% above 4Q25 as high-end IC substrate demand offset fewer working days; 1Q26 operating profit rose NTD 389.2 Mn from 4Q25, driven by steady demand for server and switch IC substrates. The company says component shortages constrained PC and consumer-electronics sales growth, the ongoing high-end switch upgrade in data centers kept its networking revenue contribution elevated, automotive demand remained weak, and its AI/HPC data-center revenue contribution was on par with 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q26 revenue NTD 11.1 Billion (+32.1% YoY, +0.1% QoQ); operating profit +NTD 389.2 Mn QoQ

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya PCB IR presentation: MOPS 804620260611E001 (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Future product development (company, June 2026): as hyperscalers keep expanding data-center capex, Nan Ya PCB is collaborating closely with customers to develop next-generation ABF substrates for AI server ASICs and developing substrates for high-end switches and routers; in BT substrates it is partnering with customers on next-gen server and power IC substrates to meet AI chips' high-efficiency power requirements; in conventional PCB it is mass-producing high-end PCBs including server network cards, backplanes and high-layer switch boards.
